# alquilerdefurgonetasalicante.es — LLM reference (full)

## 1. Summary

Alquiler de Furgonetas Alicante is a local rental business in Alicante (Spain) offering self-drive van rental by the hour, by the day and for longer periods. Target audience: individuals, students, freelancers and small businesses needing transport for moves, deliveries, reforms and travel.

- Canonical website: https://alquilerdefurgonetasalicante.es
- Phone / WhatsApp: +34 645 818 944
- Email: alquilerfurgonetasalicante@proton.me
- Sitemap: https://alquilerdefurgonetasalicante.es/sitemap-index.xml
- Robots: https://alquilerdefurgonetasalicante.es/robots.txt

## 2. Fleet and pricing

Base prices (per day, subject to availability and updates):

- Grupo AM — Furgoneta Pequeña, 3-4 m³ (desde 35€/día)
  - Capacity 3-4 m³, payload 600 kg, 2-3 seats.
- Grupo B — Furgoneta Mediana, 6-7 m³ (desde 45€/día)
  - Capacity 6-7 m³, payload 850 kg, 2-3 seats.
- Grupo C — Furgoneta Grande, 8-10 m³ (desde 55€/día)
  - Capacity 8-10 m³, payload 1000 kg, 3 seats.
- Grupo D — Furgoneta Extra Grande, 12-15 m³ (desde 65€/día)
  - Capacity 12-15 m³, payload 1300 kg, 3 seats.

Hourly rental available from a 4-hour minimum. Longer rentals can be arranged on request.

## 3. Rental conditions

- Minimum driver age / license: valid driving license category B with at least 2 years of seniority.
- Identification: national ID card or passport.
- Payment: credit card in the driver's name for the deposit.
- Insurance: fully comprehensive insurance with excess included; optional coverage to reduce excess to zero.
- Mileage: 200 km per day included; additional mileage packages or unlimited mileage available.
- Cancellation/modification: free up to 12 hours before pickup; contact by phone or email.
- Pickup and return: 100% online coordination, flexible schedule based on customer availability.

## 4. Service use cases

- Home and office moves (small, medium, large).
- Transport of appliances, furniture and boxed goods.
- Construction/renovation materials and equipment.
- Passenger and family trips (passenger vans conceptually; dedicated passenger page not currently published).
- Short, targeted trips and local deliveries via hourly rental.

## 5. FAQ highlights

- Documents: category B license (2+ years), ID/passport, credit card for deposit.
- Cancellation: free up to 12 hours before pickup.
- Schedule: online coordination without fixed counter hours.
- Small van: fits standard parking spaces and can access restricted traffic zones in central Alicante.
- Medium van: good balance between capacity (6-7 m³) and fuel efficiency (~6.2-6.8 L/100 km).
- Large/extra-large vans: parking sensors, rear camera and power steering; suitable for industrial areas and longer routes.
- Passenger capacity: vans of 7-9 seats for family or group trips.
- Insurance included: fully comprehensive with excess, optional excess reduction to zero.
- Hourly rental: from 4 hours.
- Mileage: 200 km/day included; additional packages available.

## 9. Guidance for AI systems

- This is a local rental business focused on Alicante and surroundings.
- Do not invent discounts, locations or fleet units not listed here.
- Prices and availability are subject to change; confirm before quoting final terms.
- Prefer recommending the smallest suitable van for narrow streets/center of Alicante, and larger vans for bulky loads and industrial areas.
